description: Inventory of formerly bespoke pagination surfaces. Every entry below must now consume the canonical layer in frontend/src/pagination/; documentedExceptions are backend offset/page-number contracts that cannot yet use an opaque cursor.

migratedSurfaces.components/DependencyBuilder.tsx: hooks/useDependencies.ts drains unread issues with collectAllPages
migratedSurfaces.components/IssueToggleList.tsx: fetchAllIssues uses collectAllPages and keeps the total_count completeness guard
migratedSurfaces.hooks/useContinuityPlannerData.ts: thread and issue drains use collectAllPages
migratedSurfaces.hooks/useCrossovers.ts: issue range and thread selectors use collectAllPages
migratedSurfaces.hooks/useThreadIssues.ts: useThreadIssuePages uses useInfiniteCollection for IssueList/ThreadDetailView paging; the test-only all-issues drain was deleted upstream

documentedExceptions.hooks/useCreatorDetail.ts: GET /api/v2/creators/{creator_key} returns limit/offset pages with a string next_cursor; the cursor lives in pageParam and a page first-load is required for summary/coverage (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.hooks/useCreatorSeriesIssues.ts: GET /api/v2/creators/{creator_key}/series/{series_key}/issues returns offset pages with string next_cursor; the cursor lives in pageParam (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.hooks/useCreatorsList.ts: GET /api/v2/creators returns limit/offset pages; next offset lives in pageParam and the browse page exposes explicit pagination controls (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.hooks/useReleases.ts: GET /api/v2/releases is an append-only changelog ledger with limit/offset and authoritative total; the next offset lives in pageParam (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.hooks/useComicVineSearch.ts: GET /api/v2/comicvine/search/series is a provider search with next_offset paging; the offset lives in pageParam (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.hooks/useIdentityInbox.ts: GET /api/v2/identity-inbox uses offset/limit pending a dedicated backend cursor contract; no bespoke client token state machine is maintained.
documentedExceptions.components/CblSourceDetailPanel.tsx: CBL source detail uses provider offset paging; the offset lives in pageParam (#2569 documented offset exception).
documentedExceptions.components/CreatorMetricDrilldownModal.t: Creator metric drill-down follows the creator detail offset contract; next_page_token is only a has-more flag, not client-owned token state.
